name: com.fatcat.feedback
description: Game feel for kids' learning games, animated with DOTween: Juice (pop, hop, shake, squash, arcs, slides), UiChoreography (screen elements enter and leave staggered), FeedbackStamp (right/wrong stamp, sparkles, line with the reason, streaks, peeking character), FeedbackCelebration (end card with stars) and CheckBellButton (counter-bell check button). Requires DOTween (Demigiant) in the project; uses only its core API, so the DOTween modules need no asmdef.
